instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have sent money to this month and unfriend everyone else.
notes: Current date is 2023-05-18, so 'this month' = transactions with created_at >= 2023-05-01T00:00:00; venmo.show_transactions is called with direction='sent' and that min_created_at (paginate if needed, dedupe receivers). venmo.search_friends (no query) lists current friends. The target state is: friend(p) iff p received money from the supervisor this month. Persons already friends who were paid need no call; other paid users get add_friend; remaining friends get remove_friend (the evaluator requires exactly these added/removed Friendship rows and no updates). Because a single lookup call reveals all emails at once (no quantified effects allowed), emails are static (email-of ?p ?e) facts gated by the knowledge predicates (recipients-known)/(friends-known) that the two lookups produce. To let supervisor-complete-task's precondition be exactly the task goal without quantification, the required changes are chained into a worklist (worklist-head/worklist-next) ending at the domain constant worklist-end; each add/remove advances the head, so (worklist-head worklist-end) holds exactly when every required befriend/unfriend has been performed. The extra ?p and ?n parameters of add/remove are bookkeeping, not API arguments. The problem instantiates a representative world (1 user to befriend, 1 paid user already a friend, 2 friends to remove) giving the 8-call reference plan; at runtime the worklist is built from the two lookup results.
